summary: TestFlight Round-2 (v1.0.9 / build 116) regression. Backend: 8/8 pass (test_iter85_testflight_round2.py) — health, founders open=true w/ 496 remaining, FP Café is row 0 with pinned+protected+persistent flags, /api/voice/transcribe reachable (422 not 404), jigsaw catalogue is fully curated Unsplash (no picsum/_GENERATED), member@friendplace.com.au / TestPass2026! login works, demo-login for frankie works, onboarding start endpoint reachable. Frontend (mobile web preview): Lounge tab renders FP Café as first pinned row with '📌 ALWAYS OPEN' badge + 'Pull Up a Chair' button (no 'Coffee Lounge' / 'Lounge tab' wording). Profile route /user/[id] no longer shows floating George butterfly — only inline header butterfly (testID='george-butterfly-header') is present. Deep member-journey UI steps (mic in FP Café/DM, George event approval, edit flow, founders reply wording, auto-read persistence, onboarding thank-you turn) could NOT be exhaustively verified because (a) the Round-2 review request is a 15-step continuous journey too broad for one automated session, and (b) login into the web preview was intermittent (first session succeeded, two subsequent fresh sessions submitted the Log-in Pressable but stayed on /auth/login). The Frank profile page therefore rendered blank in one attempt due to 401 (no auth token). These items are LLM-driven and rely on Emergent-managed keys; code-review-based verification below confirms the FIX CLAIMS are all in place, but functional end-to-end confirmation on device is still recommended before TestFlight upload.

ui_bugs.issue: When the logged-in member has no friends, the screen shows a red 'Failed to load' toast overlay (with 'No friends found yet.' empty state above it). The toast is likely triggered by a background fetch (e.g. suburb-based recommendation or milestone check) returning non-2xx. Console shows a 401 at the same time. Not blocking sign-off but jarring for a first-time member. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/friends.tsx

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings still present (legacy, not introduced by Round-2). Recommend a sweep to migrate to boxShadow/textShadow/style.pointerEvents before publishing.

Console warning: 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' — expected in web preview, harmless on iOS build. Confirm on device build.

action_items: Main agent: run a manual pass on the seed member (member@friendplace.com.au / TestPass2026!) covering the 15-step journey — the automation cannot reliably drive George's LLM turns in a single session, and login into the web preview was intermittent (2 of 3 automated logins stayed on /auth/login after clicking the Pressable). Playwright-safe login path likely needs an explicit testID='login-submit' button.

Investigate Friends screen 'Failed to load' toast on empty-state (401 in console). Either surface a friendlier empty state or wrap the failing fetch in a silent catch when the user has zero friends. Path: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/friends.tsx.
OPTIONAL: sweep remaining `shadow*` / `textShadow*` / `pointerEvents` deprecations before shipping — non-blocking but noisy in the console.
